description.en: Open the Explorer at Hesperocyon to inspect the linked, locator-bearing source claim together with this package's current occurrence context. This is a reproducible evidence entry point, not a phylogenetic result or a complete history of the group.
description.zh: 在探索器中打开黄昏犬，结合本包当前的出现记录背景检查带有精确来源定位的关联声明。这是可复现的证据检查入口，不是系统发育结果，也不是该类群的完整历史。

limitations: The linked claim retains its own specimen, stratum, model, confidence and source-locator boundaries. The Explorer route does not establish an exact origin, global first or last appearance, direct ancestry, causal mechanism or package-specific phylogeny.

title.en: Dormaalocyon Dormaal dental and tarsal window
title.zh: Dormaalocyon 多马尔牙齿与跗骨窗口

description.en: Open the rounded 55.9 Ma window for the Dormaal Tienen Formation sample, where IRSNB M2095–M2099 and tarsal specimens IRSNB M2107–M2109 document the named early carnivoraform evidence.
description.zh: 打开约 5590 万年前的多马尔提嫩组窗口，检查 IRSNB M2095–M2099 牙齿标本与 IRSNB M2107–M2109 跗骨标本所记录的具名早期食肉形类证据。

limitations: The 56–55.8 Ma selector is a bounded Dormaal sample envelope from the Tienen Formation, Belgium; it is not a global carnivoraform FAD, a genus duration or an ancestor date.

Dental and tarsal anatomy are observations, while genus assignment, arboreal capability and basal placement are morphology-based interpretations. The sparse, non-random sample does not establish complete distribution, direct ancestry or exact specimen-to-map co-location.

title.zh: Puijila 豪顿组运动形态窗口

description.en: Open the rounded early-Miocene window for holotype NUFV 405 from the Haughton Formation lake deposit on Devon Island, and inspect the associated skeleton behind the linked pinnipedimorph evidence.
description.zh: 打开德文岛豪顿组湖相沉积中正模 NUFV 405 的约略早中新世窗口，检查与鳍足形类证据关联的完整关联骨架。

limitations: The 24–20 Ma selector is a broad early-Miocene formation translation for one Nunavut skeleton, not a pinnipedimorph FAD, a genus LAD or a continuous transition duration.

The associated skeleton and its anatomical mosaic are observations; semi-aquatic locomotion, pinnipedimorph placement and an Arctic freshwater transition are morphology, topology and palaeoenvironmental interpretations. This record does not establish direct ancestry, complete distribution or exact specimen-to-map co-location.

title.en: Panthera blytheae Zanda Basin pantherine window
title.zh: 布氏豹 Zanda 盆地豹亚科窗口

description.en: Open the 5.95–4.10 Ma magnetostratigraphic window for IVPP V18788.1–3 from the Zanda Basin, alongside the combined fossil–molecular pantherine analysis.
description.zh: 打开 Zanda 盆地 IVPP V18788.1–3 所在的 5.95–4.10 Ma 磁性地层窗口，结合化石–分子豹亚科分析进行检查。

limitations: The 5.95–4.10 Ma selector follows the original Zanda Basin locality magnetostratigraphy and the named partial cranial sample; it is not a universal pantherine FAD, species LAD or unchanged age model.

Specimen anatomy and locality are observations, while Panthera assignment, snow-leopard affinity and an Asian biogeographic scenario are analytical hypotheses. The sampled markers do not establish complete distribution, direct ancestry or exact specimen-to-map co-location.
